purpose: Reusable mechanism library for SAP Sales. Process variants reference mechanisms instead of duplicating determination/configuration logic.

entity_class.meaning: A reusable SAP decision/control mechanism that consumes context, applies configured logic and writes a result used by downstream process behavior.

code_contract.stability_rule: Author mechanism codes are stable graph identifiers. SAP transactions, apps, scope-item IDs and release-specific standard keys remain attributes or references, never primary IDs.

separation_rules: Process answers what business branch is running; mechanism answers what system control decides behavior.
Master data and configuration are inputs to a mechanism, not embedded prose inside each process.
Standard keys are stored only when the cited release/scope makes them explicit; behavior is preferred over pretending an example key is universal.
Failure modes must name the upstream proof path, not only the downstream symptom.
